description: MOSMEO crystallizes in the orthorhombic crystal system with space group P b c a. Reported CIF formula moiety: C38 H42 N4 O12 Tb1 Zn2 1+,Cl1 O4 1-. From the CIF bond table, Tb1 (Tb) has 8 O neighbors; Zn1 (Zn) has 3 O neighbors; Zn2 (Zn) has 3 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 2 pairs, 1 components; largest component is a chain with approximately linear metal-site arrangement. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 3.611-3.642 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 110.59-111.67°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula C23H24.5N2O10YbZn.
